dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized indentation visible on the posterior-left lateral margin, congruent with the termination of the dorsal ridge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Extremely diffuse; gradual gradient between lighter and darker grey skin regions with no sharp demarcations.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, linear, low-contrast striae (rake-like marks) visible across the right-center dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Deep, high-contrast longitudinal indentation with irregular, jagged margins running parallel to the central dorsal axis on the left side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, deep longitudinal scar or structural deformation located on the left aspect of the dorsal ridge; several minor superficial linear scratches on the mid-dorsal skin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, circular dark-pixel aperture (blowhole) at the anterior terminus; prominent dorsal ridge with asymmetrical structural damage.
